title: Compose Stock count case worklist with preserved approval context
head: feature/stock-count-cases-demo
body:
Stock count cases now use selectable summaries for SKU, batch, location and exact current state, with the existing evidence/actions in focused details. Each row remains one recorded snapshot; no multi-line count session or hidden first/recount quantity is invented. Busy commands preserve selection and dialogs retain their original case/version/retry target across list refreshes.

Stacked on #1183 (`feature/stock-counts-due-demo`). Parent business script is unchanged except the component import. Original article conditions, report privacy, authority flags and handlers remain intact; writeoff uses a renderless pass-through of the same articles, with no new disclosures or wrapper. No existing assertion, backend, grant or migration changes.

Validation includes nine new rendered/runtime tests (actual parent dialog target retention/branch clearing, mounted details, stable IDs, busy guard, writeoff parity, focus and no-document SSR), existing STK23 tests, and governed-stock/difference-report backend30/548. Final full2239/2239 frontend, types/lint/format and production build passed. Real synthetic three-actor flow refused original-counter recount and recounter approval, then independently posted exactly one unit stocktake loss; immutable history retained versions1–4. Four390/1440 light/dark captures meet owned44/36 targets without overflow/JS errors. Writeoff smoke shows no new case controls.

Evidence/frozen patch and independent review: `/workspace/kpone-validation/stock-count-cases/`. This is a bounded case-worklist composition, not full Stock/demo or writeoff makeover. Draft only; exact-head CI required; no merge.
